name: Data Cleanup Daily
script:
# Code for Server Script (Scheduler Event, Daily).
# Uses only safe_exec API: frappe.*, log, enqueue (safe_enqueue).

JOB_TIMEOUT = 3000

log("Data Cleanup: start")
rules = frappe.get_doc("Data Cleanup Rules")
today = frappe.utils.getdate()
log("Data Cleanup: today=%s" % (today,))
enabled_version = sum(1 for r in (rules.version_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_comment = sum(1 for r in (rules.comment_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_file = sum(1 for r in (rules.file_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_comm = sum(1 for r in (rules.communication_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_event = sum(1 for r in (rules.event_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_workflow = sum(1 for r in (rules.workflow_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
log("Data Cleanup: rules enabled Version=%s Comment=%s File=%s Communication=%s Event=%s Workflow=%s" % (enabled_version, enabled_comment, enabled_file, enabled_comm, enabled_event, enabled_workflow))

frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_version", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup Version")
frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_comment", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup Comment")
frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_file", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup File")
frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_communication", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup Communication")
frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_event", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup Event")
frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_workflow", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup Workflow")

log("Data Cleanup: enqueued 6 cleanup jobs (Version, Comment, File, Communication, Event, Workflow)")

name: Data Cleanup Version
script:
PAGE_LENGTH = 500
MAX_PACK = 10

def get_one_page(doctype, filters, order_by="name", start=0, or_filters=None):
	return frappe.get_all(
		doctype,
		filters=filters,
		or_filters=or_filters or [],
		fields=["name"],
		order_by=order_by,
		limit_start=start,
		limit_page_length=PAGE_LENGTH,
		pluck="name"
	)

log("Data Cleanup Version: start")
rules = frappe.get_doc("Data Cleanup Rules")
today = frappe.utils.getdate()
log("Data Cleanup Version: today=%s" % (today,))
deleted_total = 0
for row in (rules.version_rules or []):
	if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
		log("Data Cleanup Version rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
		continue
	cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
	log("Data Cleanup Version rule days=%s ref_doctype=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, row.get("ref_doctype") or "", cutoff))
	filters = [["creation", "<", cutoff]]
	if row.get("ref_doctype"):
		filters.append(["ref_doctype", "=", row.ref_doctype])
	count = 0
	pack_count = 0
	page_num = 0
	start = 0
	while True:
		names = get_one_page("Version", filters, order_by="creation", start=start)
		if not names:
			break
		page_num = page_num + 1
		for name in names:
			try:
				frappe.delete_doc("Version", name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
				pack_count = pack_count + 1
				count = count + 1
				if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
					frappe.db.commit()
					log("Data Cleanup Version: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
					pack_count = 0
			except Exception as e:
					frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Version delete error for %s" % (name,), e, "Version", name)
					log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Version %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
		log("Data Cleanup Version: page %s, deleted batch %s, total so far %s" % (page_num, len(names), count))
		start = start + PAGE_LENGTH
	if pack_count:
		frappe.db.commit()
	deleted_total = deleted_total + count
	log("Data Cleanup Version rule days=%s ref_doctype=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, row.get("ref_doctype") or "", count))
log("Data Cleanup Version: finished total_deleted=%s" % (deleted_total,))

                    count = count + 1
                    if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:

                except Exception as e:
                    frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Comment delete error for %s" % (name,), e)
                    log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Comment %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
            if pack_count:
                frappe.db.commit()
            ref_start = ref_start + PAGE_LENGTH
    deleted_total = deleted_total + count
    log("Data Cleanup Comment rule days=%s reference_doctype=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, row.get("reference_doctype") or "all", count))
log("Data Cleanup Comment: finished total_deleted=%s" % (deleted_total,))

name: Data Cleanup Event
script:
PAGE_LENGTH = 500
MAX_PACK = 10

log("Data Cleanup Event: start")
rules = frappe.get_doc("Data Cleanup Rules")
today = frappe.utils.getdate()
log("Data Cleanup Event: today=%s" % (today,))
deleted_total = 0
for row in (rules.event_rules or []):
    if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
        log("Data Cleanup Event rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
        continue
    cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
    log("Data Cleanup Event rule days=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, cutoff))
    query_base = """
        SELECT name FROM tabEvent
        WHERE GREATEST(
            COALESCE(starts_on, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'),
            COALESCE(ends_on, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'),
            COALESCE(CONCAT(IFNULL(repeat_till, '1000-01-01'), ' 00:00:00'), '1000-01-01 00:00:00')
        ) < %s
    """
    query_extra = ""
    args_base = [cutoff]
    if row.get("event_category"):
        query_extra = query_extra + " AND event_category = %s"
        args_base.append(row.event_category)
    if row.get("event_type"):
        query_extra = query_extra + " AND event_type = %s"
        args_base.append(row.event_type)
    if row.get("status"):
        query_extra = query_extra + " AND status = %s"
        args_base.append(row.status)
    count = 0
    pack_count = 0
    page_num = 0
    offset = 0
    while True:
        query = query_base + query_extra + " ORDER BY name LIMIT %s OFFSET %s"
        args = tuple(args_base) + (PAGE_LENGTH, offset)
        names = [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql(query, args)]
        if not names:
            break
        page_num = page_num + 1
        for name in names:
            try:
                frappe.delete_doc("Event", name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
                pack_count = pack_count + 1
                count = count + 1
                if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
                    frappe.db.commit()
                    log("Data Cleanup Event: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
                    pack_count = 0
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Event delete error for %s" % (name,), e, "Event", name)
                log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Event %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
        log("Data Cleanup Event: page %s, deleted batch %s, total so far %s" % (page_num, len(names), count))
        offset = offset + PAGE_LENGTH
    if pack_count:
        frappe.db.commit()
    deleted_total = deleted_total + count
    log("Data Cleanup Event rule days=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, count))
log("Data Cleanup Event: finished total_deleted=%s" % (deleted_total,))

script:
PAGE_LENGTH = 500
MAX_PACK = 10

def get_one_page(doctype, filters, order_by="name", start=0, or_filters=None):
    return frappe.get_all(
        doctype,
        filters=filters,
        or_filters=or_filters or [],
        fields=["name"],
        order_by=order_by,
        limit_start=start,
        limit_page_length=PAGE_LENGTH,
        pluck="name"
    )

log("Data Cleanup Workflow: start")
rules = frappe.get_doc("Data Cleanup Rules")
today = frappe.utils.getdate()
log("Data Cleanup Workflow: today=%s" % (today,))
deleted_total = 0
for row in (rules.workflow_rules or []):
    if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
        log("Data Cleanup Workflow rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
        continue
    cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
    log("Data Cleanup Workflow rule days=%s reference_doctype=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, row.get("reference_doctype") or "", cutoff))
    if frappe.db.exists("DocType", "Workflow Action"):
        filters_wa = [["modified", "<", cutoff]]
        if row.get("reference_doctype"):
            filters_wa.append(["reference_doctype", "=", row.reference_doctype])
        if row.get("status"):
            filters_wa.append(["status", "=", row.status])
        count = 0
        pack_count = 0
        start = 0
        page_num = 0
        while True:
            names = get_one_page("Workflow Action", filters_wa, order_by="modified", start=start)
            if not names:
                break
            page_num = page_num + 1
            for name in names:
                try:
                    frappe.delete_doc("Workflow Action", name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
                    pack_count = pack_count + 1
                    count = count + 1
                    if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
                        frappe.db.commit()
                        log("Data Cleanup Workflow Action: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
                        pack_count = 0
                except Exception as e:
                    frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Workflow Action delete error for %s" % (name,), e, "Workflow Action", name)
                    log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Workflow Action %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
            log("Data Cleanup Workflow Action: page %s, deleted batch %s, total so far %s" % (page_num, len(names), count))
            start = start + PAGE_LENGTH
        if pack_count:
            frappe.db.commit()
        deleted_total = deleted_total + count
        log("Data Cleanup Workflow rule days=%s doctype=Workflow Action deleted=%s" % (row.days, count))
    if frappe.db.exists("DocType", "Workflow Task"):
        filters_wt = [["modified", "<", cutoff]]
        if row.get("reference_doctype"):
            filters_wt.append(["doc", "=", row.reference_doctype])
        if row.get("status"):
            if row.status == "Completed":
                filters_wt.append(["status", "in", ["Completed", "Cancelled"]])
            elif row.status == "Open":
                filters_wt.append(["status", "=", "Working"])
        count = 0
        pack_count = 0
        start = 0
        page_num = 0
        while True:
            names = get_one_page("Workflow Task", filters_wt, order_by="modified", start=start)
            if not names:
                break
            page_num = page_num + 1
            for name in names:
                try:
                    frappe.delete_doc("Workflow Task", name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
                    pack_count = pack_count + 1
                    count = count + 1
                    if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
                        frappe.db.commit()
                        log("Data Cleanup Workflow Task: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
                        pack_count = 0
                except Exception as e:
                    frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Workflow Task delete error for %s" % (name,), e, "Workflow Task", name)
                    log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Workflow Task %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
            log("Data Cleanup Workflow Task: page %s, deleted batch %s, total so far %s" % (page_num, len(names), count))
            start = start + PAGE_LENGTH
        if pack_count:
            frappe.db.commit()
        deleted_total = deleted_total + count
        log("Data Cleanup Workflow rule days=%s doctype=Workflow Task deleted=%s" % (row.days, count))
log("Data Cleanup Workflow: finished total_deleted=%s" % (deleted_total,))
